svg.title: H for Hotel and Restaurant Menu
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold H becomes a dining-inspired mark with cutlery and an opening menu. It leads into hotel, restaurant and digital menu examples. The H is redrawn for hospitality using the original H poster's strong colour palette.
svg.metadata: 16:9; 1920 by 1080; 6.5-second loop; inspired by the palette and H composition of 08_H_hoardings.png; no external assets.

g.text: A BEAUTIFUL MENU FOR EVERY EXPERIENCE.
